leads.name: Torshizi & Marsella 2026: LLM-based selection of incongruent verbal and nonverbal behavior for virtual humans (arXiv 2608.22731)
leads.why: Below the salience bar for avatars/nonverbal and behavioral: two online Prolific video-rating studies (within-subjects, N = 49 and N = 39) of LLM-chosen mismatched nonverbal behaviour, with no immersive setup and no venue yet.
